_comment: SWAO LZ Service Catalogue Template. Copy this file to your workspace at wsp/inputs/catalogs/lz-catalogues/<provider>.json and fill in the fields below. JSON does not support comments natively; remove all _comment fields before using.

meta._comment_meta: Catalogue-level metadata. All fields are required unless noted.
meta._comment_schema_version: Always '0.1' for the current schema generation. Do not change.
meta.name: My Private Cloud service catalogue
meta._comment_name: Human-readable name shown in 'swao lz catalogue list'.
meta._comment_provider: Unique machine-readable identifier. Use kebab-case. Must match the filename (my-private-cloud.json). Register in index.json if you want SWAO to discover it automatically.
meta._comment_last_updated: ISO-8601 date when this file was last manually reviewed or updated.

source._comment_source: Provenance block. Describes where the data came from.
source._comment_mode: Closed enum: api | scrape | curated | botocore-endpoints | pim-api-stackit. Use 'curated' for hand-authored files.
source._comment_operator: Name of the person or team who authored/maintains this catalogue.
source.source_note: Hand-authored from internal cloud team documentation. Reviewed 2026-08-11. Key management confirmed with platform team 2026-07-30. Certifications per ISO certificate #CERT-12345 issued 2025-03-01.
source._comment_source_note: Free-text provenance note. Include URLs, document references, review dates, and any data-freshness caveats. This is the primary audit trail for data quality.

meta._comment_confidence: Enum: high | medium | low. high = machine-sourced, verified. medium = hand-curated from authoritative docs. low = partial / unverified.
meta._comment_regions_count: Number of region objects in the regions array. Must match.

regions._comment_region_1: First region -- primary site, high sovereignty profile.
regions._comment_id: Region identifier. Use a stable, kebab-case string. Will appear in assessment output and framework rules.
regions._comment_display: Optional human-readable description shown in the TUI. Include location, tier, or noteworthy details.
regions._comment_country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the physical data centre location.

sovereignty._comment_sovereignty: Sovereignty facts for this region. Stored as facts only; verdicts are computed by installed frameworks (D-LZ-07).
sovereignty._comment_residency_country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where data physically resides. Omit if genuinely unknown (e.g. Azure Local where the customer chooses the site).
sovereignty._comment_operator_jurisdiction: Free-form string describing the legal jurisdiction of the cloud operator. Common values: 'EU-entity' (EU-incorporated, EU-staff), 'US-entity' (US-incorporated, CLOUD Act attaches), 'operator-site' (customer premises -- jurisdiction is the customer's).
sovereignty._comment_extraterritorial_exposure: Array of known extraterritorial legal exposure vectors. Common values: 'us_cloud_act' (US CLOUD Act applies to operator), 'fisa_702' (US FISA 702 applies). Empty array means no known extraterritorial exposure.
sovereignty._comment_certifications: Array of confirmed third-party certifications. Valid SWAO vocabulary: BSI_C5, ISO_27001, SOC_2, TISAX_L3. Only include certifications that have been issued (not 'planned' or 'in progress'). Record in-progress ones in source_note instead.

services._comment_code: Unique service identifier within this region. Use the official provider service name. Must be unique within this region's services array.
services.name: Virtual Machines
services._comment_name: Optional human-readable name. Can be the same as code or more descriptive.
services._comment_status: Enum: ga (generally available) | preview (limited availability, no SLA) | announced (on roadmap, not yet orderable) | retired (previously available, now discontinued).
services._comment_fulfills: SWAO assessment vocabulary -- what workload capability this service provides. Multiple values allowed. Common values: vm_compute, kubernetes, container_orchestration, serverless_compute, batch_compute, object_storage, block_storage, file_storage, postgresql, mysql, sql_server, nosql_database, redis, search, key_vault, secrets_management, identity_management, vpc_networking, load_balancer, dedicated_connectivity, vpn, waf, dns, cdn, monitoring, audit_logging, threat_detection, compliance_monitoring, backup, data_analytics, data_warehouse, ml_training, ml_inference, managed_llm, queue, messaging, event_streaming, data_integration, big_data, bi_analytics, api_gateway, container_registry, vdi. Use [] if no standard vocabulary match exists -- add capabilities instead.
services._comment_capabilities: Free-form capability tags for this service. Use kebab-case. Examples: gpu-h100, trusted-launch, bare-metal, dedicated-tenancy, auto-scaling, kafka-compatible, oracle-rdbms, fips-140-2-level-3-hsm. Frameworks can match on capabilities when fulfills has no vocabulary match.
services._comment_key_custody: Who controls the encryption keys for data stored by this service. Multiple values reflect the options the service offers. Enum: provider-managed (provider holds keys; default), cmk (customer-managed key stored in provider KMS), byok (customer imports own key material into provider KMS), hyok (customer holds keys outside the provider; provider only sees references), operator-managed (for on-prem/HCI -- the hosting organisation holds keys).
services._comment_last_verified: ISO-8601 date when this service entry was last manually confirmed against provider documentation.
services._comment_source: Source of this specific service entry. For hand-authored files use 'curated'. Automated adapters stamp their source tool here.

services._comment_service_4: Example: announced service (on roadmap, not yet orderable).
services.name: Object Storage

regions._comment_region_2: Second region -- disaster recovery site, lower sovereignty profile.
